title: Assessing mRNA translation in mouse adult microglia and macrophages
author: Antignano, Keane, et al.

steps.title: Prepare L929 conditioned medium
steps.instruction: Harvest supernatant from confluent L929 cells, filter, and store as L929 conditioned medium (L929CM) according to the Materials and Equipment section; keep on ice or at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: Isolate adult brain cells
steps.instruction: Optionally perfuse mice, sacrifice, remove brain, dissociate with Miltenyi Adult Brain Dissociation Kit (skip Red Blood Cell Lysis), perform debris removal per manufacturer, count cells, and resuspend to 2 × 10⁶ cells per 100 µL in microglia medium (MM).

steps.title: Prepare FACS staining stock
steps.instruction: For each sample (final 120 µL volume) mix 0.6 µL anti‑CD11b‑BUV395 (1:2000), 0.6 µL anti‑CD45‑BV711 (1:2000), 0.12 µL LIVE/DEAD Fixable Near‑IR (1:10000), 0.6 µL TruStain FcX (1:2000) and 8.0 µL FACS Buffer to a total of 10 µL; keep on ice, protect from light, and prepare immediately before use.

steps.title: Prepare 5 FAM‑Azide staining solution
steps.instruction: For each condition combine 1 µL Cell‑Based Assay 5 FAM‑Azide Stock (1:10000), 1 µL Copper Sulfate (1:10000), 1 µL Ascorbic Acid (1:100) and 98.8 µL Cell‑Based Assay Buffer (1X) to 100 µL total; protect from light, store at 18‑24 °C, and prepare immediately before use.

steps.title: Plate brain cells for assay
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µL of the brain cell suspension (2 × 10⁶ cells/100 µL) into each well of a V‑bottom 96‑well plate according to experimental conditions.

steps.title: Centrifuge and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin plate at 400 × g for 5 min at 18‑24 °C, carefully aspirate supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet, and proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Cycloheximide pre‑treatment
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Cycloheximide solution to CHX+OPP wells, mix gently without bubbles; add 100 µL microglia medium (MM) to all other wells, mix; incubate 15 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: OPP incubation
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL OPP stock to OPP and CHX+OPP wells, mix gently; add 10 µL fresh medium to the remaining wells; incubate 1 h at 37 °C (final volume 110 µL per well).

steps.title: Surface marker staining
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL FACS staining stock to OPP, CHX+OPP and no‑OPP wells; add 10 µL MM to the unstained control; add 10 µL MM containing live/dead dye to the live/dead control; mix gently, protect from light, incubate 10 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash after surface staining
steps.instruction: Spin plate at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature, carefully aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL 4 % PFA/PBS per well, mix gently, protect from light, incubate 5 min at 18‑24 °C.

steps.title: Wash post‑fixation
steps.instruction: Spin at 400 × g for 5 min at 18‑24 °C and aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Three washes with Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 200 µL Cell‑Based Assay Wash Buffer (contains 0.1 % Polysorbate 20), incubate 5 min at RT protected from light; spin 400 × g 5 min at 18‑24 °C, aspirate; repeat for a total of three washes.

steps.title: FAM‑Azide staining
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL 5 FAM‑Azide staining solution, incubate 30 min in the dark at 18‑24 °C; spin 400 × g 5 min at 18‑24 °C and aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Post‑staining washes
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 200 µL Wash Buffer, incubate 5 min at 18‑24 °C protected from light; spin 400 × g 5 min at 18‑24 °C, aspirate; repeat wash two more times for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Final resuspension for flow
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 200 µL Assay Buffer (1X), mix well, transfer to FACS tubes, keep on ice and protected from light, and proceed immediately to flow cytometry analysis. (Optional: use 100 µL for maximal recovery and a second 100 µL wash.)

steps.title: Harvest bone marrow cells
steps.instruction: Sacrifice mouse, collect femur and tibia, flush bones with HBSS using a 5 mL syringe and 27‑gauge needle, strain through a 70 µm filter into a 50 mL tube, wash filter with 5 mL HBSS, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min at 18‑24 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in HBSS to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Count and seed bone marrow cells
steps.instruction: Count cells, adjust to 12 × 10⁶ cells/mL in BM medium (BMM); add 1 mL of this suspension to each 150 mm dish containing 15 mL BMM + 4 mL L929CM (final volume 20 mL, L929CM 20 % v/v); gently tilt dish to distribute cells evenly.

steps.title: Differentiate macrophages
steps.instruction: Incubate dishes at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 6 days. On day 4, remove ~10 mL medium and add 8 mL BMM + 2 mL L929CM (maintaining 20 % L929CM). On day 6, wash twice with pre‑warmed DPBS (no Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺).

steps.title: Detach and collect BMDMs
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in pre‑warmed dissociation buffer for 10 min at 37 °C/5 % CO₂; check detachment and continue incubation if needed; gently scrape, collect suspension with a 10 mL pipette; wash dish with 5 mL pre‑warmed DPBS, scrape again, collect second suspension, combine; centrifuge 300 × g 10 min at 18‑24 °C, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare BMDM single‑cell suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in BMM, count cells, adjust to 50 000 cells/100 µL (no L929CM), plate 50 000 cells per well (≥2‑3 technical replicates), incubate 12‑16 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to allow adherence.

steps.title: Stimulate BMDMs (optional)
steps.instruction: Treat adhered BMDMs with experimental stimulus (e.g., 100 ng/mL LPS for 3 h) on day 7, then proceed to the translation assay starting at step 1 (plate cells for OPP assay).
